title: Greeb
body:
Description

Greeb is found in Grimestone and previously in Marble, pre the 1.37.0 update. It has a bright green color and a metallic material when refined. It can most easily be found in the Acid Wastes within Grimestone.

As of the most recent major update to Oaklands [1.17.0], Acidlands has been removed and replaced with the Icelands. The location of Grimestone, Uranium, and Greeb have all been moved to Mike's Mines behind a destructible wall near the entrance of the Farland's (according to the Mike's Mine map) as a temporary home.

Greeb was a joke ore and originated in the community Discord. Proudism, a user in the community, had posted several fake pictures on 1/14/2023, Annual Greeb Day, of an "unknown green ore", which then started a chain of jokes and comments to add it to the game.

Trivia

  • Greeb is referenced in the description of the Dark alley vinyl disk.
  • Greeb can drop from goblins
  • Greeb features sound effects made by Theofficialbrick, in a video titled 'Oaklands Greeb Sound Audition'.
  • Greeb is the main focus point of the Gift of Greeb.
  • Greeb produces a much different sound when Refined or Forged, compared to most other materials.
